title: Le Creuset – Vintage Cast Iron Casserole – Model F – Enameled Cast Iron
description:
Beautiful vintage casserole by Le Creuset, crafted in high-quality enameled cast iron. Model F, featuring a very attractive and elegant colour, typical of the timeless French design for which Le Creuset is renowned.
This piece combines both functionality and aesthetics: perfect for everyday cooking while also serving as a decorative item in any kitchen.
Like all vintage items, please carefully review the photos to fully appreciate its exact condition and details, as they form part of the description.
Brand: Le Creuset
Model: F
Material: enameled cast iron
Compatibility: all hobs, including induction
Condition: good (see photos for full condition details)
A beautiful French-made piece, both practical and decorative, ideal for slow cooking, stews, roasts, soups, and a wide variety of homemade dishes.

fr.title: Le Creuset – Cocotte vintage en fonte – modèle F – fonte émaillée
